verses.text: At that time the followers came to Jesus and asked, "Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"
Jesus called a little child to him and made the child stand among them.
Then he said, "I tell you for certain, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
So whoever makes themselves humble like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
And whoever welcomes a little child like this in my name welcomes me.
"But suppose someone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin. It would be better for that person to have a large millstone hung around their neck and be drowned in the deep sea.
How terrible it will be for the world because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things will certainly come, but how terrible it will be for the person who causes them!

If your hand or your foot makes you sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with a hand or foot missing than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that burns for ever.
And if your eye makes you sin, pull it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
"Make sure you do not look down on one of these little ones. I tell you that their angels in heaven are always with my Father in heaven.
The Son of Man came to save what was lost.
"What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?
And if he finds it, I tell you for certain, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander away.
In the same way, your Father in heaven does not want any of these little ones to be lost.
"If your brother or sister sins against you, go and talk to them about it, just between the two of you. If they listen to you, you have won them back.
But if they will not listen, take one or two others with you. Then everything that is said can be confirmed by two or three witnesses.
If they still refuse to listen, tell it to the church. And if they refuse to listen even to the church, treat them as you would treat someone who does not know God, or a tax collector.
"I tell you for certain, whatever you forbid on earth will be forbidden in heaven, and whatever you allow on earth will be allowed in heaven.
"Again, I tell you for certain that if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
Where two or three people come together in my name, I am there with them."
Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times should I forgive my brother or sister when they sin against me? Up to seven times?"
Jesus answered, "I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy times seven.
"So the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
As he began to do this, a man was brought to him who owed him ten thousand bags of gold.
The man was not able to pay. So his master ordered that he, his wife, his children and everything he owned be sold to pay back the debt.
"The servant fell on his knees in front of him. 'Be patient with me,' he begged, 'and I will pay back everything.'
The master felt sorry for him. He let him go and cancelled the whole debt.
"But when that servant went out, he found one of the other servants who owed him a hundred silver coins. He grabbed him and began to choke him. 'Pay back what you owe me!' he said.
"The other servant fell on his knees and begged him, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay it back.'
"But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay back the debt.
When the other servants saw what had happened, they were very upset. They went and told their master everything that had happened.
"Then the master called the servant in. 'You wicked servant,' he said. 'I cancelled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.
Should you not have had mercy on the other servant, just as I had mercy on you?'
The master was very angry. He handed him over to the jailers to be punished until he could pay back everything he owed.
"This is how my Father in heaven will treat each of you, unless you forgive your brother or sister from your heart."
